slot.brief: Given atomic masses of parent, daughter and alpha particle, compute Q-value/energy released in alpha decay using mass defect; medium-difficulty numerical.

stem: The neutral atomic masses of a parent nucleus, its daughter nucleus and a helium atom are $226.0250$ u, $222.0174$ u and $4.0026$ u, respectively. Find the energy released in the $\alpha$ decay. Take $1$ u $=931.5$ MeV/$c^2$.
solution:
The mass defect is $.0050$ u.
$$Q=.0050\times 931.5=4.6575\text{ MeV}
$$
Hence, the energy released is approximately $4.66$ MeV.
